_comment: Tax and invoicing policy for ColleagueAI sales. NOT APPROVED. It records the accountant's decisions (Accountant Decision Pack, questions T1-T14) and nothing in the code assumes them: while status is 'unapproved', live checkout is refused (lib/taxPolicy.js liveTaxBlocked), no Stripe Tax is calculated, no invoice is created and no tax wording is printed. To approve it: fill every decision and treatment with the accountant's written answer, set approval (who, role, date, and where the written answer is filed) and status 'approved'. tests/tax-policy.test.mjs refuses an 'approved' policy with any blocking decision, treatment or approval field left empty. Treatments are per buyer category (lib/taxPolicy.js classifyBuyer); 'action' is sell | hold | block, and every printed wording comes from here, never from code.
